scenes.narration: Bullets introduce key ideas with diamond markers, indigo ink, and cel drop shadows.
Compare places options side by side, from flat paper styling to cel-sky panels.
Steps walk through a sequence: sketch the layout, paint the cel bands, and ink the outlines.
Flow connects stages in a line, from script to audio to rendered video.
Fanout routes one theme context into backdrop layers, cards, and captions.
Tables organize structured comparisons across primary, secondary, and accent tokens.
Graph lays out branching nodes automatically, sending data from router to cache or worker.
Sequence traces messages over time: client sends a request, server checks state, and returns a reply.
Class diagrams show data models, where ThemeDef holds palette tokens and CelTokens.
Mermaid handles complex state machines with loops: queued jobs validate, check the cache, start rendering, retry on timeout, and finish as done or failed, keeping every branch clear on screen.

visual.heading: Mermaid
visual.code:
stateDiagram-v2
  direction LR
  [*] --> Queued
  Queued --> Validating: submit
  Validating --> CacheCheck: valid
  CacheCheck --> Rendering: miss
  Rendering --> Retrying: timeout
  Retrying --> Rendering: retry
  CacheCheck --> Done: hit
  Rendering --> Done: encoded
  Validating --> Failed: invalid
  Retrying --> Failed: limit
  Done --> [*]
visual.caption: Complex state machine with cache bypass and retry loop
